gen-dafont-ostrich-sans-fs-erode: Erode lets its g and a open broadly, with strokes that swell and thin gently. And Ostrich Sans stands tall and tightly closed, a minimal foil that is pleasant for a quick look.
gen-dafont-ostrich-sans-fs-paquito: Towering lowercase and tightly pressed letters give Ostrich Sans a luxurious, minimal hush. But Paquito, confident and approachable, with caps close to its lowercase height, is better for a quick line.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-anek-kannada: Synthwave swagger: Outrun Future runs wide-spaced in one unbroken line. Anek Kannada, a modern sans-serif with terminals held far from the stem and a lofty lowercase, keeps paragraphs open and easy going.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-cossette-tex: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide, tracing synthwave authority in one constant outline. Cossette Texte, a neutral sans-serif with a wide-eyed lowercase e and a prominent x-height, reads smoothly and without fuss.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-fresca: Authoritative and synthwave, Outrun Future stretches its wide-set letters along a constant outline. Fresca, a modern sans with short ascenders above big bowls, looks best given a generous size.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans holds its stroke widths steady, with an e opened like a pried clasp. Funnel Sans handles quiet detail while Outrun Future owns the wide, outlined, synthwave shout.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-gidole: Wide-spaced and synthwave, Outrun Future draws every curve in one steady outline. And Gidole, uniform as neon tube, keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, a quieter neighbor to all that glow.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-golos-text: Outrun Future traces every letter in one wide-spaced, constant outline. Golos Text, a sans with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s, reads in an approachable, contemporary way.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai fills the line with s curves opening wide at both ends and stroke ends cut from one ribbon. Beside Outrun Future's wide outline, it reads approachably, line after line.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-krub: Synthwave Outrun Future spreads its letters wide, while Krub follows with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves left unfinished. Best of all is the heading's lack of stress in every curve.
